detail.investigation: 1 of 3 unmuted failures is new; prior build #3.0.2636 had 78 fails (76 new), so this run is a big improvement - 3 fails, 1 new, pass rate 99.8%. The new failure is QuotaGroup > ChangeOrderFlowTestSteps 'change order flow: two audiences request, evaluation, approve': a Spock assertion `assert status.isChangeOrderNeeded == true` failed because AudienceChangeStatus returned with every field null (quotaGroupId/lineItemGuid/isChangeOrderNeeded/blockTraffic all null, only changeRequested=true) - a response-shape/data problem, not a Read-timeout/502/504, so not infra. The other two failures are NOT new: QuotaGroupWorkflowTestSteps 'Move quota group...' is a genuine infra timeout (Read timed out on POST .../clone against microservices-qa), and PesNotificationTestSteps 'tally mode update...' is a data/setup HTTP 400 (total quota < soft-launch quota) on a shared fixture. On changes: NXS-13444 (ba799a167eb1, gergely.gimesi) touches only dashboard/data/ai-platform.json and dashboard/tools/generate_ai_platform.py (automation - cannot cause test failures); NXS-13454 (1c8bfbed601a, gergely.gimesi) touches .cursor rules, CURSOR.md, docs/DEPENDENCIES.md and build.gradle (resolve nxs jars from Artifactory latest.release) - none of which map to the QuotaGroup rest-gateway / audience-change area. No commit plausibly maps to the failing area, so this is treated as test-data/fixture or a QA-service response issue, not a code regression.
